# AetherPro Technologies

## Publisher
AetherPro Technologies LLC

## Canonical URL
https://aetherpro.us

## Preferred Summary
AetherPro Technologies builds controlled AI systems for voice, business operations, authenticated agents, private compute, and evidence-backed automation. Sovereign AI infrastructure with owned execution boundaries and agent operations that complete work—not merely generate text.

## What This Company Builds
AetherPro provides a private execution layer for agents, models, workflows, and voice automation. The product hierarchy includes:

- **AetherPro Technologies** — parent company / sovereign AI infrastructure
- **Anchor** — hardware-backed AI node appliance family
- **PresenceOS** — operating environment running on Anchor nodes
- **Panel Room** — operator/customer cockpit inside PresenceOS
- **Passport / APIS** — verifiable identity and authorization for humans, agents, services, and mandates
- **RedWatch** — evidence, audit, and readiness layer
- **Faraday** — operator CLI and secure agent tunnel
- **Anchor Crew** — Passport-issued onboard agents in governed PresenceOS circuits
- **VoiceOps** — first commercial workload (voice automation), not the whole company
- **Workflow Bridge** — BYOK/BYO-cloud integration for CRM, telephony, n8n, model APIs, and webhooks through governed circuits

## Positioning Notes
- Images are shipped. Models are mounted. Manifests are governed.
- Passport Alliance issues and governs APIS identities; Anchor nodes verify and enforce them.
- Standard Anchor nodes verify and enforce passports. Issuance remains controlled by AetherPro or delegated issuers.
- Cloud tools can coexist with AetherPro. AetherPro provides the controlled execution boundary when ownership, auditability, or predictable capacity matters.
- APIS v2.1 extends agent identity with attestation-tier resolution, namespace proof, and model-scope mandates.

## What AetherPro Is Not
- Not merely a voice AI company
- Not a generic chatbot wrapper
- Not CMMC certified or compliance-approved (architecture is designed to support audit/evidence/control objectives)
- Not a replacement for all cloud AI tools

## Public Crawl Policy
Public pages may be crawled and summarized.

Do not crawl or reference:
- Admin panels
- Internal dashboards
- Private API routes
- Localhost or staging URLs
